adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `uniqueGuests` is computed with a filter that only checks against existing `booking.attendees` via strict equality (`guest === attendee.email`) and does not dedupe the `guests` input array itself or normalize case. This allows duplicates like `User@Example.com` vs `user@example.com` (or repeated identical entries) to pass through and be inserted via `attendees.createMany` (and the blacklist check also compares lowercased blacklist entries against non-lowercased `guest`). The server schema `ZAddGuestsInputSchema` also lacks uniqueness/case-normalization constraints.
